question: Who among the following was appointed, to the UN tax committee in July 2021, as a member for the 2021 to 2025 term?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rasmi Ranjan Das**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rasmi Ranjan Das** was appointed to the UN tax committee in July 2021.
 
• The appointment is for the **2021 to 2025 term**.
 
• The UN tax committee is responsible for addressing issues related to international tax cooperation and policies.
 
• Rasmi Ranjan Das is recognized for his expertise in international tax matters and his contributions to the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **UN Committee of Experts on International Cooperation in Tax Matters** is a subsidiary body of the Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC).
 
• The committee works to enhance international tax cooperation and assist countries in their efforts to mobilize domestic resources for development.
 
• It provides guidance on tax matters, including tax treaties, transfer pricing, and tax avoidance and evasion.
 
• The appointment of experts to the committee is based on their technical expertise and experience in tax policy and administration.
